cases.title: Enable rejects non-overlapping protocol ranges
cases.when: A package declares sdk.protocol 3..3 while hosts advertise 1..2
then: Enable is rejected naming the ranges

cases.title: Tool Host registration advertises protocol and launcher
then: protocol {min,max}, launcherVersion and tiers are recorded

cases.title: The launcher re-verifies the artifact digest
cases.when: The mounted artifact differs from the permit digest
then: The launcher refuses to start with a fixed code

cases.title: The entry point starts with a cleared environment and fixed argv
cases.when: The host process has extra environment variables
then: The tool sees only the documented variables and argv

cases.title: Frames pass through unchanged
cases.when: A tool emits every frame kind
then: Bytes at the host equal bytes from the tool

cases.title: The launcher enforces frame size and deadline
cases.when: A tool emits an oversized frame, then never exits
then: Each fails with a fixed launch code

cases.title: New packages run on the oldest supported host and client
cases.when: The fixture package runs on the oldest supported Tool Host and endpoint client
then: Calls succeed or enable rejects with a range error

cases.title: CONTAINER packages include a compatible launcher or speak v2
cases.when: A CONTAINER package without a launcher and not speaking v2
